# Player state

`cinnabar:extension/player-state@0.1.0`

Read-only, session-bound facts about the local player's presented inventory and effects.

**Grants:** `player_state` for local observations; actor reads instead require `players` or `entities` for their kind.

## Types

<a id="type-item"></a>

### `item`

One presented item stack, retaining wire identity when a name is unavailable.

```wit
record item {
    identifier: option<string>,
    network-id: s32,
    metadata: u32,
    count: u16,
    block: bool,
    damage: option<u32>,
    max-durability: option<u32>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `identifier` | `option<string>` | None when the negotiated registry cannot resolve the item. |
| `network-id` | `s32` |  |
| `metadata` | `u32` |  |
| `count` | `u16` |  |
| `block` | `bool` | Canonical block-item route or a retained wire block identity. |
| `damage` | `option<u32>` | Accepted response corrections take precedence over the stack's Damage tag. |
| `max-durability` | `option<u32>` | None for items without a known durability maximum, including custom components. |

<a id="type-slot"></a>

### `slot`

Preserves whether a cell is known separately from whether it contains an item.

```wit
record slot {
    known: bool,
    item: option<item>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `known` | `bool` | False until this inventory cell has authoritative or selected-equipment evidence. |
| `item` | `option<item>` |  |

Types: [`item`](player-state.md#type-item).

<a id="type-effect"></a>

```wit
    effect-id: s32,

}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `effect-id` | `s32` |  |
| `amplifier` | `s32` | The wire amplifier is zero-based and is not a display level. |
| `remaining-ticks` | `option<u64>` | Remaining 20 Hz server ticks; none is an infinite effect. |

| `particles` | `bool` |  |

<a id="type-snapshot"></a>

### `snapshot`

Inventory and effects from one session and dimension; unknown cells stay in place.

```wit

    session: u64,
    dimension: s32,
    selected-slot: option<u8>,
    inventory: list<slot>,
    armor: list<slot>,
    offhand: slot,
    effects: list<effect>,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session` | `u64` |  |
| `dimension` | `s32` |  |
| `selected-slot` | `option<u8>` |  |
| `inventory` | `list<slot>` | Exactly 36 cells, with hotbar cells first, in the host's presented inventory order. |
| `armor` | `list<slot>` | Helmet, chestplate, leggings, boots, with unknown cells preserved. |
| `offhand` | `slot` |  |
| `effects` | `list<effect>` | Currently visible status effects, sorted by effect id, without expired entries. |

<a id="type-combat-kind"></a>

### `combat-kind`

`totem` is a totem-of-undying activation on `runtime-id`, local or remote, and `death` a
server death notice. Read event lives with `read-combat-lives` and current actor lives
with `read-actor-lives`.

```wit
enum combat-kind {
    attack-admitted,
    hurt,
    death,
    totem,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `attack-admitted` |  |  |
| `hurt` |  |  |
| `death` |  |  |
| `totem` |  |  |

<a id="type-world-time"></a>

### `world-time`

The server world clock: `time` is the absolute ticks the server last set, advanced at 20
per second while its daylight cycle runs, 24000 per day. `daylight-cycle` is the server's
daylight-cycle rule. Visual time overrides never apply.

```wit
record world-time {
    session: u64,
    time: s64,
    daylight-cycle: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `session` | `u64` |  |
| `time` | `s64` |  |
| `daylight-cycle` | `bool` |  |

<a id="read-motion"></a>

### `read-motion`

```wit
read-motion: func() -> result<option<motion>, string>;
```

Read-only presented motion; requires player-state authority, including while menus own input.

<a id="read-vitals"></a>

### `read-vitals`

```wit
read-vitals: func() -> result<option<vitals>, string>;
```

Authoritative current food attributes; unknown fields remain absent, never estimated.

Types: [`vitals`](player-state.md#type-vitals).

<a id="read-ping"></a>

### `read-ping`

```wit
read-ping: func() -> result<option<u32>, string>;
```

Actual upstream round-trip milliseconds; absent before measurement or when unsupported.

<a id="read-actors"></a>

### `read-actors`

```wit
read-actors: func() -> result<list<actor>, string>;
```

At most 16 nearby actors within 128 blocks; player rows require players, other rows entities.

Types: [`actor`](player-state.md#type-actor).

<a id="read-actors-limited"></a>

### `read-actors-limited`

```wit
read-actors-limited: func(limit: u32) -> result<list<observed-actor>, string>;
```

Reads a smaller prefix of the same authorized observations to bound guest copying work.
limit is 1 through MAX_OBSERVED_ACTORS; filtering and session authority are unchanged.

Types: [`observed-actor`](player-state.md#type-observed-actor).

<a id="read-actor-lives"></a>

### `read-actor-lives`

```wit
read-actor-lives: func(runtime-ids: list<u64>) -> result<list<option<actor-life>>, string>;
```

One entry per requested runtime ID, in order, regardless of distance or the actor reads'
limit: none when the session has no such admitted actor in the current dimension, or the
caller lacks the grant for its kind. Player rows require players, other rows entities.
At most MAX_ACTOR_LIFE_READS IDs; shares the actor reads' callback allowance.

Types: [`actor-life`](player-state.md#type-actor-life).

<a id="read-combat"></a>

### `read-combat`

```wit
read-combat: func(after: u64, limit: u32) -> result<list<combat-event>, string>;
```

Incremental retained evidence, at most 4 entries per read. Requires player-state authority.
Attack admission is outbound intent, NOT server confirmation; hurt carries NO attacker attribution.

Types: [`combat-event`](player-state.md#type-combat-event).

<a id="read-combat-lives"></a>

### `read-combat-lives`

```wit
read-combat-lives: func(sequences: list<u64>) -> result<list<option<u64>>, string>;
```

The actor's `read-actor-lives` life when each combat event was recorded, in request order.
Death events carry the life after the death. Compare lives within one session.
None when the event is no longer retained, belongs to another session or dimension, or
the caller cannot read it. Requires the same grants as `read-combat` and shares its
callback allowance. At most MAX_COMBAT_LIFE_READS sequences.

<a id="read-chat"></a>

### `read-chat`

```wit
read-chat: func(after: u64, limit: u32) -> result<list<chat-message>, string>;
```

Newest 32 retained received messages, filtered by sequence > after, in FIFO order.
limit is 1 through 4; individual text fields are at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

Types: [`chat-message`](player-state.md#type-chat-message).

```wit
read-world-time: func() -> result<option<world-time>, string>;
```

sets a time.

Types: [`world-time`](player-state.md#type-world-time).

<a id="read-snapshot"></a>

### `read-snapshot`

```wit
read-snapshot: func() -> result<option<snapshot>, string>;
```

Requires the player-state grant. None outside the current connected session.
Available while a screen owns input; carries no camera, interaction or packet authority.

Types: [`snapshot`](player-state.md#type-snapshot).

<a id="read-revision"></a>

### `read-revision`

```wit
read-revision: func() -> result<option<u64>, string>;
```

Exact content token for the current snapshot, scoped to this component instance.
None outside a current snapshot. Shares the read-snapshot grant and read budget.
Contents equal to the last full read reuse its token, even after unimported changes.

<a id="read-revisions"></a>

### `read-revisions`

```wit
read-revisions: func() -> result<option<revisions>, string>;
```

Independent exact observation tokens. Equipment is unaffected by ticking effects.
Tokens advance on observed changes and never repeat within an instance, including reconnects.
These three reads share read-snapshot's grant, bounds, and callback read allowance.

Types: [`revisions`](player-state.md#type-revisions).

<a id="read-equipment-matches"></a>

### `read-equipment-matches`

```wit
read-equipment-matches: func(identifier: string) -> result<option<equipment-matches>, string>;
```

Requires player-state authority and shares its read budget. None outside a session.
Identifier must contain 1..MAX_ITEM_IDENTIFIER_BYTES bytes.

Types: [`equipment-matches`](player-state.md#type-equipment-matches).
